> **AI Summary:** Claim denied. Telehealth psychotherapy with interactive complexity billed — but GT was applied to both codes incorrectly, the treatment-plan reference required by ASES is missing, and interactive complexity is not separately documented in the note.

---

## Issues Found — 3 Errors · 1 Warning

### 🔴 Error 1 — GT Modifier Misapplied to Add-On Code
GT must be on **90837 only** — not on the add-on 90785.  
ASES denied both lines because of this modifier placement error.

### 🔴 Error 2 — Treatment Plan Reference Missing
ASES requires a **treatment-plan date and clinician signature** in the clinical note for every 90837 claim.  
None was found on this claim.

### 🔴 Error 3 — Interactive Complexity (90785) Undocumented
**90785** requires a separate paragraph describing caregiver involvement or communication complexity.  
This documentation is not present in the note.

### ⚠️ Warning — Telehealth Platform Not Named
ASES requires the **telehealth platform name** (e.g., Doxy.me, Zoom for Healthcare) documented in the clinical note.

---

## Suggested Fixes

### Fix 1 — Remove GT from 90785
GT is a primary-service modifier — apply it to **90837 only**.  
Leave 90785 without any telehealth modifier per ASES billing rules.

### Fix 2 — Add Treatment-Plan Date and Signature to the Note
Without a valid treatment-plan reference, ASES will not reimburse 90837.  
Add the date the plan was last updated and the supervising clinician's signature.

### Fix 3 — Document Interactive Complexity Separately
Add a dedicated section to the note describing the specific complexity factors that justified billing 90785:
- Caregiver present during session
- Language barrier
- Safety concerns or crisis management

## Pro Tip — Biller & Coder Reference

### CPT 90837 — Psychotherapy, 60 minutes (53+ min)
- **Units:** 1/day
- **Billing note:** Plan Vital: treatment-plan date required in note. Modifier GT for telehealth.

### CPT 90785 — Interactive complexity (add-on)
- **Units:** 1/day
- **Billing note:** Add-on only with 90832/90834/90837. Documents caregiver involvement or other complexity.

### Modifier GT — Via interactive audio and video telecommunications
- **Payer:** Plan Vital / ASES / Medicaid
- **Rule:** Required for all ASES/Plan Vital telehealth services. Replaces POS 02 in many ASES contracts.
